usedFor: Planyo Online Booking holds reservations; Google Docs gets text from “New Payment Received” via “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Payment Received” in Planyo Online Booking, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each payment becomes text in a Google Doc tab you choose, either appended or in place of what was there.

watchOut: “Reservation Modified by Customer” fires on edits, so one reservation can write to the tab again.
